§6Rock Crusher§f

§aBreaks down stone into component minerals.§f
The §bRock Crusher§f takes §b1 item input§f and produces §b3 item outputs§f. Default cycle is §b400 ticks§f at §b20 RF/t§f. It's NuclearCraft's answer to the Macerator, breaking down stone and other hard materials into their mineral components.

Use it for processing stone into gravel, sand, and mineral dusts. It's faster than the Manufactory for stone-based recipes and produces more diverse outputs per cycle. The 3 output slots give you variety.

§ePS:§f The Rock Crusher has 3 output slots. Make sure your piping can handle all three output streams to avoid one backing up and stalling the entire machine.
